newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best places Integon rating under review.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best places Integon rating under review.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said on Wednesday it has placed Integon Corp's "B+" (Very Good) rating under review with developing implications after it agreed to be acquired by a unit of General Motors Corp.

The developing implications reflect the uncertainty regarding the structure of the transaction and the benefits to Integon of being owned by a financially stronger parent, such as GM's General Motors Acceptance Corp.
The successful completion of the transaction should enable Integon to reduce its high underwriting leverage, through reinsurance or a capital infusion, A.M. Best said.

The purchase price includes $550 million to holders of Integon's common and convertible preferred shares. The transaction cost will also include $150 million in long-term debt, $100 million of capital securities and short-term debt outstanding at the closing, A.M. Best said.
Integon's rating will remain under review pending the close of the transaction, A.M. Best said.
